title: Roobert

history.summary:
## What I did
- Synthesized and completed all 6/6 planned sections for the Roobert / Monopo Saigon editorial studio website.
- Fixed truncated Features.css and restored all card, grid, and typography styling.
- Upgraded Testimonials.tsx from raw prompt fallback to interactive client endorsement carousel with star ratings.
- Fixed Contact.tsx CSS import and styling with Saigon atelier hours toggle.
- Built the missing 6th section Footer.tsx & Footer.css with navigation links, atelier locations, and colophon.
- Re-bundled App.tsx with clean modular imports.

## Status
- ✅ All 6 sections complete.
- ✅ Vite production build clean with 0 errors and 0 CSS warnings.
history.content: Synthesized site with 13 files across 6 sections.
